options.text: Provisions five Azure scaling scenarios (VM, VM Scale Set, App Service, Azure SQL Serverless) plus a live monitoring dashboard, each running ScaleTrigger - six resource groups in total, named from the prefixes on the next step. Estimated cost at these defaults: roughly $10/day, $312/month while left running (see automatic/README.md for the full breakdown).

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Azure region for every resource this template creates.

elements.name: adminUsername
elements.label: Admin username
elements.toolTip: Administrator login for the VM, VM Scale Set, and SQL Server.

constraints.validationMessage: 3-20 characters, must start with a letter; letters, digits, and hyphens only.

elements.name: adminPasswordControl
elements.toolTip: Administrator password for the VM, VM Scale Set, and SQL Server - the only field with no default. Must meet Azure's password complexity rules: 12+ characters, at least 3 of lowercase / uppercase / digit / special character. Only the length is checked here; the full rule is enforced by Azure at deployment time.

elements.name: resourceGroupPrefix
elements.label: Resource group prefix
elements.toolTip: Applied to all six resource group names, e.g. "<prefix>-SingleVM".

constraints.validationMessage: 1-61 characters: letters, digits, periods, underscores, hyphens.

elements.name: resourcePrefix
elements.label: Resource name prefix
elements.toolTip: Applied to resource names inside those groups, e.g. "<prefix>-vm". The SQL Server and Web App additionally get a random suffix appended to stay globally unique.

constraints.validationMessage: 1-21 characters, must start with a letter; letters, digits, and hyphens only.

elements.name: approvalNotificationUpn
elements.label: Approval notification account (UPN)
elements.toolTip: Azure AD account that receives a push notification (Azure mobile app) when the App Service plan's approval-gated vertical scaling alert fires. Leave blank to use a placeholder that notifies no one - fine for trying the rest of the demo, but that one scenario won't do anything useful until you set a real account here.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid email/UPN, or leave blank.

elements.name: autoShutdownEnabled
elements.label: Automatically shut down the VM Scale Set daily
elements.toolTip: Limits cost when the demo is left idle. The single VM always gets its own shutdown schedule regardless of this setting.

elements.name: autoShutdownHour
elements.label: Auto-shutdown hour (UTC)
elements.toolTip: UTC hour (0-23) the daily shutdown fires - kept in UTC rather than converted to a local time zone.
